items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: Interesting when you compare somebody like Jim Europe with Piron, it makes Piron sound red hot.

ctx.x: Records came down here, they didn't believe it was Oliver hardly, but it didn't sound like him. And I've heard that from other people too.
Interesting when you compare somebody like Jim Europe with Piron, it makes Piron sound red hot. Yeah, that's right. I don't know if you've ever sat down and listened to those songs.
